title: Knowledge of movement effects, not movement, is necessary for experience

statements.text: Action is not necessary for experiencing. What is necessary is knowledge of how movements affect sensory stimulation, so a paralyzed person can see if that person once had some control over visual input, and brief or still stimulation is perceived by the modality it is lawfully linked to.

sources.quote: It is not our claim that action is necessary for experiencing.
providing that the person had at some time previously had some kind of control over her visual input
